author: Sam Illingworth
basis: Parent anecdote and proposed education-policy practices
reported_outcomes: Reports a child repeating an anti-AI position learned from other children; does not report outcomes of the five proposed practices.
proposed_outcomes: Hear children’s existing use and concerns before setting or revising rules.
limits: The article’s legal and policy claims were not independently refreshed in this review.
Listening does not replace adult responsibilities or tool assessment.
The article itself recognizes uncertainty; comparisons with other prohibition policies are analogies, not causal AI evidence.
review_note: Extract the conversation routine only. Do not adopt a blanket verdict for or against school bans.
coverage: Close-read all 149 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
